visibility_contract.visible_feedback: TRAIN_PUBLIC environment/oracle checker events with event_type environment_feedback or checker_output and child_received=true preserve exact text and structured feedback, including observed score/outcome/correctness fields.
visibility_contract.unknown_visibility: Unlabelled top-level outcome fields are rejected, not guessed public or silently stripped. Explicit source visibility must be supplied by native integration.
visibility_contract.audiences: TRAIN: parent/head/exchange; DEV: head only; FINAL: none of parent/head/exchange. Broker only accepts registered TRAIN; helper validate_audience_split is exposed for other owners, not proof their head/exchange paths enforce it.

authorization: WATCHER_RELAYED_ROHIN_DONE bound to exact config; old GO/grace/silence rejected
prompt_pairing: Per-request Fn/principles/policy/system hashes and exact node-archived Fn bytes retained. Version/alignment mismatch is a non-gating contrast limitation.

hourly_contract.native_fields: Child tokens and optimizer steps are null/UNKNOWN without a source-hashed matching-interval native receipt; never inferred from parent calls or cycles.
hourly_contract.scheduler: No hourly process launched; callable reduction for Main's reporter.

remaining: audited Fn prompts and watcher-relayed DONE
raw_policy: All real archives remain node-only with bounded temporary VM transport; no raw captures in this manifest.
